draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.40, the 229th-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 10th of 11 at QB. He went 166th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (229th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (80th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (99th percentile), three-cone (99th percentile). College production: 2,752 passing yards in 2018, 9th of 11 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 8 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers (practice squad). 6 career games and 4 starts over 2 completed seasons. His 2023 season (4 AV) was his best yet. Weak spots: approximate value 4 (12th percentile), epa per dropback -0.18 (14th percentile). Played 5 of 17 games in 2023. Versus the typical Year-5 quarterback who played: 1,129 passing yards against a median of 1,226, below the norm.
